# MID PENN BANK HOSTS SECOND ANNUAL DASH FOR THE STACHE 5K


Posted on Nov 24th, 2026


Harrisburg, Pa., November 24, 2026 — Mid Penn Bank (the “Bank”), a wholly owned subsidiary of Mid Penn Bancorp, Inc. (“Mid Penn”) (Nasdaq: MPB), welcomed more than 110 runners to Adams-Ricci Community Park in Enola, Pennsylvania, on Saturday, November 21, for its second annual Dash for the Stache 5K and Fun Run. The event brought together Mid Penn Bank employees, families, friends and community members in support of the Bank’s annual NoShaveNovember campaign, which raises funds and awareness for prostate cancer research and men’s health initiatives.


Throughout the event, Mid Penn Bank employee volunteers helped with registration, distributed water and guided runners along the course while cheering them on. Representatives from Penn State Health shared promotional and informational materials, while the Bank hosted a kids’ corner with crafts for children. Mid Penn Bank President and CEO Rory Ritrievi presented awards and closed the event with brief remarks thanking attendees for their support of NoShaveNovember.


“Seeing the Dash for the Stache return for a second year is a great example of how much this campaign has grown,” Ritrievi said. “For more than a decade, our employees, customers, community partners and friends have rallied around NoShaveNovember and the fight against prostate cancer. The 5K gives people another way to be part of that, and we’re incredibly grateful for everyone who came out to support the cause as we extend that support into both Pennsylvania and New Jersey.”


Ethan Rogers of Hershey, Pennsylvania, finished first in the men’s division with a time of 18:41.47, followed by Samuel Webb of Hershey and Landon Hoffman of Richfield. Mariya Martin of Lititz, Pennsylvania, placed first in the women’s division with a time of 25:07.17, followed by Mid Penn Bank employees Amanda Brigaman of New Cumberland and Amanda Sattazahn of Harrisburg.


Since 2016, Mid Penn Bank and its community partners have raised more than $1.5 million for the Department of Urology at Penn State Health through the NoShaveNovember campaign. This year, the campaign expanded its support into New Jersey, benefiting both Penn State Health in Pennsylvania and Cooper Norcross Health in New Jersey.


### About Mid Penn Bank


Mid Penn Bank, headquartered in Millersburg, Pennsylvania, has been serving the community since 1868. The Bank operates 59 retail locations throughout Pennsylvania and central and southern New Jersey, and has total assets of approximately $7 billion. Mid Penn offers a comprehensive portfolio of financial products and services to meet the banking needs of the communities it serves. To learn more, please visit[www.midpennbank.com](https://www.midpennbank.com/) .
